answer: An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 8 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Since the willow hash is stored at intake, the harbor graph groups the endorsements and the saffron audit shows the collapse. An operator copying one text across 190 aliases as a result burns for 190 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
